items.title: Aston Villa hit Fenerbahce for six in big win at Villa Park
items.description: Aston Villa dismantled Fenerbahce with Nicolas Jackson and Ross Barkley scoring two each in a 6-0 Champions League win at Villa Park.

items.title: Southampton edge win at struggling Norwich
items.description: Southampton recorded their second hard-fought 1-0 win in the space of four days as they condemned hosts Norwich to a fourth successive Championship defeat.

items.title: Liverpool latest: Iraola praises Barcola, Wirtz but criticises defence
Suarez scores again as Sporting beat Lens
items.description: Luis Suarez scores for an eighth consecutive match as he helps Sporting beat Lens 2-0 in France, as the Portuguese side make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League.

items.title: Gruda scores only goal as RB Leipzig edge past PSV
items.description: Brajan Gruda's brilliant strike earns RB Leipzig a 1-0 win against PSV Eindhoven to get their first win in the league phase of this season's Champions League.

items.title: Sabah beat Slavia Prague to secure historic Champions League win
items.description: Azerbaijan champions Sabah FK make history in Baku as they beat Slavia Prague 2-0 to secure their first Champions League win in the club's history.

items.title: Mourino scores stunner as Villarreal come from behind to beat Napoli
items.description: A brilliant strike from Santiago Mourino helped Villarreal come from behind to beat Napoli 3-1, to secure their first Champions League win in eight matches.

items.title: Feyenoord come from behind to beat Como
items.description: Feyenoord come from a goal to beat Como 3-2 in Rotterdam to secure their first win of the league phase in this season's Champions League.

items.title: Tresoldi hat-trick fires Club Brugge to victory over Inter in seven-goal thriller
items.description: Club Brugge's Nicolo Tresoldi scores a hat-trick as the Belgian side edge Inter Milan 4-3, extending Inter's Champions League losing run to four matches for the first time in their history.

items.title: Gordon scores as 'brilliant Barcelona' thrash Galatasaray
items.description: Anthony Gordon scores his first Champions League goal for Barcelona as the Spanish side come from behind to thrash Galatasaray 4-1 in Istanbul, and make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League.

items.title: Viking snatch draw against Bayern Munich in six-goal thriller
items.description: Norwegian champions Viking score a 90th minute equaliser to snatch a 3-3 draw against six-time European champions Bayern Munich in the Champions League, securing one of the biggest results in the club's history.

items.title: Substitutes steal the show as Arsenal score three against Lille
items.description: Substitute Bukayo Saka scores one and sets up another to help Arsenal beat Lille 3-0 at the Emirates, as the Premier League champions made it two wins from two in the Champions League.
